publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas

publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.
publication.author: Felipe Sabino

record.title: Clean stock Power-slider halt
record.method: Owner hand test with continuous UART and protected-region recovery
record.observation: Two recorded halt sequences restore camera state and complete native storage drain before PMIC power-off. The owner accepts the Power-slider route.
record.limits: This halt result does not establish ordinary restart, full suspend or power-loss durability.
